notes.title: The Creator — Game Update!
notes.content: [h3]Hello, our dear Creators![/h3][p]Today an update has been released and significant fixes and additions have been made to the game! [/p][p][b]Main points of the update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are adding and expanding the object library, and in this update you will be able to further explore new items and their settings. Added over 300 unique objects to the existing 1200 ones. Library expansion continues![/p][/*][*][p]Added smooth rotation and movement of objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added alignment of objects relative to walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added character animations in free camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added precise positioning system for more detailed placement of objects, including scaling and rotating.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to clone objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added color change system for some objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Known bugs have been fixed and some locations have been improved.[/p][/*][*][p] Stay tuned for updates and we always look forward to your feedback![/p][/*][/list][h3]Regards,[/h3][h3]The Creator Developers![/h3][h3][b]Add to Wishlist now.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940870/The_Creator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The Creator — game update!
notes.content:
Hello, our dear Creators!
A huge thank you to each and every one of you for your support, ideas, and warm words! It is precisely your feedback that inspires us to create even more awesome updates and work on the game day after day. You're the best, and your participation means everything to us!


Today, update V0.6 has been released, bringing significant fixes and additions to the game!

Key points of the update:
Optimization of locations.
Fixing identified bugs.
Adding object scaling mechanics.
And much more.
Stay tuned for updates, and we always look forward to your feedback!

With respect,
The Developers of The Creator!

notes.title: Major Update!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello friends! I received a huge amount of feedback and suggestions for improving the game and I'm eager to share the news and work done with you!

Firstly, [u]we are adding and expanding the object library[/u], so in this update you'll be able to explore new items and their settings further. Over 200 new objects have been added, and the library continues to grow!

A new feature has been introduced called Fast Shorts, which renders the result of your finished room design quickly!

When you press the "O" button, all the objects will appear before you in sequence.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557179/de284eb5600a732ab5d120f1404c5877dfe9ea3b.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT: After all objects have appeared, press "O" again to bring up the control menu.[/b][/p][p][b] This function is experimental and still under development. In "Fast Shorts" mode, you can also record a video of quick rendering by pressing "F11 + Ctrl" to start recording and "F11 + Ctrl" again to stop it. Share this video with your friends or the Steam community!  [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Add the game to your wishlist and don't miss any updates![/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940870/The_Creator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Dear friends, I wish everyone an enjoyable time and great mood! [/b][/p][p][b]Mark Miller.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Testing has started!
notes.content: [p]We are excited to announce that testing has begun and you can now try out the first version of our game![/p][p] Here's what you'll find in this release:[/p][p]Two maps: Apartment and Gardener's House.[/p][p]Various furniture sets and materials for your creative ideas.[/p][p]Please note that this is a very early version of the game, so mechanics may change. Additionally, we will be adding more content in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Regards,[/p][p]Mark Miller.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hey, Creator!
notes.content:
Have you ever dreamed of creating stylish and cozy spaces? Now you have a unique opportunity to showcase your design talents in our game dedicated to interior and exterior design. Join us and dive into the world of creativity and style!

What awaits you:

Bring your ideas to life by creating unique interiors and exteriors.
Choose furniture, decor, and accessories from a wide selection to suit any taste.
Enjoy the simplicity and ease of use of our design tools.
How to participate: Sign up for the playtest now and get exclusive access to the game before its official release. Together we can make this project even better!

Don’t miss your chance! Add the game to your wishlist today and be ready for testing to begin. Become part of our community and leave your mark on the world of virtual design. Show us what you're capable of! 
 Regards, Mark Miller.
